metadata_json.question: Choose the correct equation: Five multiplied by six equals thirty.
metadata_json.explanation: Five multiplied by six equals thirty: 5 × 6 = 30.

metadata_json.question: Choose the correct equation: Thirty divided by three equals ten.
metadata_json.explanation: Thirty divided by three equals ten: 30 ÷ 3 = 10.

metadata_json.question: Choose the correct equation: Two multiplied by nine equals eighteen.
metadata_json.explanation: Two multiplied by nine equals eighteen: 2 × 9 = 18.

metadata_json.question: Choose the correct equation: Thirty-six divided by nine equals four.
metadata_json.explanation: Thirty-six divided by nine equals four: 36 ÷ 9 = 4.

metadata_json.question: Choose the correct equation: Twenty-four divided by six equals four.
metadata_json.explanation: Twenty-four divided by six equals four: 24 ÷ 6 = 4.

metadata_json.question: There are three bears with five pears each. So there are fifteen pears in _______.
metadata_json.explanation: 3 bears × 5 pears each = 15 pears in total (tổng cộng 15 quả lê).

metadata_json.question: There are six carrots. Two boys can share the carrots equally. _______ boy has three carrots.
metadata_json.explanation: 6 ÷ 2 = 3. Each boy has three carrots (Mỗi bạn có 3 củ cà rốt).

• 10 ÷ (8 - 7): Ten divided by the difference between eight and seven

• 6 × (1 + 5): Six times the sum of one and five
